reel.caption:
₹1 lakh sitting in a savings account: how did it lose ≈ ₹3,400?

Retail inflation was 6.09% in October 2026, a two-year high.
A savings account paying 2.5% turns ₹1 lakh into ₹1,02,500.
At prices 6.09% higher, that buys what ≈ ₹96,616 bought a year ago: ≈ ₹3,384 of buying power gone.
Approximate and illustrative: your own prices and your bank's rate will differ.

How much of your money sits idle in savings right now?
Send this to the friend with idle savings.

Sources: government CPI data for October 2026 as reported by a public broadcaster and an environment-and-economy magazine (12 Nov 2026); savings rates of 2.5% at a large public bank (a business daily, Jun 2025) and at several private banks for balances up to ₹1 lakh (a rate-comparison page, rates as of Mar 2026). Illustrative only.
